title: Supertitle Alternatives & Comparisons
metaDescription: Fair comparisons of Supertitle and other caption tools: price, free plan limits, watermarks, and how each one has you edit captions.
h1: Supertitle compared with other caption tools
intro: Each comparison covers price, free plan limits, watermarks and how you edit the captions, and says plainly where the other tool is the better pick. Supertitle does one job: burned-in captions for short videos, edited as text in your browser.

faq.question: What does Supertitle do?
faq.answer: It adds burned-in captions to short videos. You upload a video, review the automatic word-by-word transcript, pick one of five styles and export an MP4.

faq.question: Is there a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Free includes {plan.free.monthlyMinutes} minutes of video a month, videos up to {plan.free.maxVideoMinutes} minutes and {plan.free.maxResolution} exports. No plan adds a watermark, Free included.

faq.question: Does Supertitle translate captions?
faq.answer: No. Captions are written in the language spoken in the video. Supertitle detects dozens of languages automatically, but it doesn't translate.
